name: mimosa
description: Local-first security guardrails for ZCode with pre-write hooks, end-of-turn review, Git gates, commands, a security-scan skill, and an optional MCP server for sealed deep scans.

description_i18n.en: Local-first security guardrails for ZCode with pre-write hooks, end-of-turn review, Git gates, commands, a security-scan skill, and an optional MCP server for sealed deep scans.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 ZCode 的本地优先代码安全防线，提供写入前 Hook、任务收尾复查、Git 门禁、命令、安全扫描 Skill，以及用于密封深扫的可选 MCP 服务。

engine.title: MCP scan engine
engine.description: Static engine used by the optional Mimosa MCP server. Use native unless a supported external engine is intentionally configured.
